display_name: The Covenant of the First Anvil

clergy.vestments: ash-grey robes beneath bronze chain with tablets of clan law
clergy.holy_symbol: square anvil framed by a ring of runes

cosmology.opposing_view_detail: Chaotic powers are named oath-breakers and furnace fiends that counterfeit divine authority through lies and ruin.
cosmology.notes: See §3.3 Alignment Cosmology Rules for the hard constraints governing this field.

pantheon.domains_summary: Supreme maker of halls, laws, and all rightful craft.
Guardian of records, true memory, witness, and judgment.
Patron of deep earth, patient sustenance, and sheltering mercy.

pantheon.holy_symbol: tower gate crossed by a road-line
pantheon.domains_summary: Defender of marches, caravans, and disciplined war against Chaos.

flavor_text.one_line: A stern dwarven faith that treats law, craft, and ancestry as one sacred chain.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Covenant teaches that the world was made fit for dwelling only when Thorum Var struck order into raw stone and set the honored dead to witness every oath thereafter. Its temples are archives as much as shrines, and priests serve as judges, engineers, and keepers of clan memory. Chaos is not merely disorder but a spiritual corrosion that unravels hall, kin, and soul alike.
flavor_text.creation_myth_summary: Thorum Var forged the first halls from primeval stone and called the worthy dead to dwell behind the walls as eternal witnesses to every oath.
flavor_text.moral_code_summary: Keep sworn word, honor clan and craft, bury the worthy with record and rite, and oppose Chaotic deceivers who would break law and lineage.
